payload.body:
## Context
Linear account/profile mapping and manual issue/project sync are implemented, including MCP tool exposure.

## Goals
- Add test coverage for `hack x linear` parse + sync paths with mocked Linear API client.
- Add MCP server assertions for new Linear tools (`hack.linear.*`).
- Add regression tests for external metadata round-trip in ticket sync.

## Notes
Focus on deterministic fixtures for bidirectional mapping (status, labels, dependencies, project/team).

## Links
- src/control-plane/extensions/linear/commands.ts
- src/mcp/server.ts
payload.title: Linear sync: add targeted integration tests

payload.body:
## Context
Manual-by-default sync is available via CLI and MCP tools.

## Goals
- Define autosync trigger model (polling/webhook/manual override).
- Define conflict resolution and source-of-truth rules for owner/source/status.
- Add rollout controls (opt-in flags, dry-run, observability).

## Notes
Keep autosync project-scoped and optional until manual flows are battle-tested.

## Links
- docs/extensions.md
payload.title: Linear sync: autosync design after manual phase
